replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Positive Aspects:
- [+0.5] Waiting parkour for Spectators
- [+1.0] Good shape of the map
- [+1.0] unusual, but good looking block palette
- [+1.0] hidden chests with balanced items

Negative Aspects:
- ([-0.5] No golden apples in the loadout) Got Fixed
- ([-1.0] Maybe a tad too many leave blocks, it looks kind of overcrowded) Got Fixed

Improvements:
- Add golden apples to the loadout (at least one)
- Remove some of the leave blocks on the team sites, the middle is fine, but still stick with the theme. For more pvp space. 

Rating:
+2.0 for now. I like the map and it has great potential to be in the rotations! Good Luck!
(The stuff I mentioned isn't set in stone, I might change everything lol)
Everything got fixed. +5.0
